description: CSV/Excel round trip for the admin catalogue: GET /admin/products/export (one row per variant in the bulk CSV column shape, rupees, '|'-joined images by position, draft+published only), client-side RFC-4180 CSV export with UTF-8 BOM from the bulk page and catalogue header, and bulkUpsert changes so re-uploading an edited export EDITS existing SKUs (title + category always, optional cells when non-blank, non-empty imageUrl REPLACES images in order, blank keeps them). Independent of FEAT-002 (no shared files).
steps: apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/product.service.ts: add exported type ProductExportRow { sku; title; categorySlug; mrp: number; sellingPrice: number; description; brand; hsnCode; taxRatePct: number; stock: number; status: 'draft'|'published'; imageUrl: string } and exported pure function toExportRows(p) taking { title, description, hsnCode, taxRatePct, status, category: { slug }, brand: { name } | null, images: { url, position }[], variants: { sku, mrp, sellingPrice, inventory: { available } | null }[] } and returning one row per variant: mrp = v.mrp / 100, sellingPrice = v.sellingPrice / 100, brand = p.brand?.name ?? '', stock = v.inventory?.available ?? 0, imageUrl = [...p.images].sort((a,b) => a.position - b.position).map(i => i.url).join('|'). Product with no variants -> [].

Same file: add async exportRows(): Promise<{ rows: ProductExportRow[] }> calling this.prisma.product.findMany({ where: { status: { in: ['draft', 'published'] } }, include: { category: { select: { slug: true } }, brand: { select: { name: true } }, images: { orderBy: { position: 'asc' } }, variants: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' }, include: { inventory: true } } }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } }) and flatMapping toExportRows. Archived products are excluded (schema has no soft-delete; deletes are hard).

apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/admin-catalogue.controller.ts: add `@Get('products/export') exportProducts() { return this.products.exportRows(); }` placed directly after `@Get('products') listProducts` and BEFORE `@Get('products/:id/detail')`. The class-level @Roles('catalogue_manager') covers it; add no new decorators.

product.service.ts bulkUpsert existing-SKU branch: set productData.title = row.title and productData.categoryId = category.id unconditionally (both are required CSV columns); keep the existing conditional description/hsnCode/taxRatePct/brandId/status assignments (blank cells arrive as undefined and stay unchanged). Replace the append-images logic: const replaceUrls = [...new Set(imageUrls)] (order preserved); delete the existingImages findMany / nextPos / imagesToAdd code; inside the existing tx: if (replaceUrls.length > 0) { await tx.productImage.deleteMany({ where: { productId } }); for each url, idx -> tx.productImage.create({ data: { productId, url, alt: '', position: idx } }) }. Blank imageUrl -> images untouched. Leave the new-SKU branch and stock/price logic unchanged. Update the bulkUpsert JSDoc to describe the edit semantics and 'last row wins' for multi-variant product-level fields.

apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/product.service.spec.ts: extend build() with option existingProducts?: Record<string, unknown>[] (pushed into products) and fake productImage.deleteMany({ where: { productId } }) that splices matching entries out of images (mutate the same array instance returned by build). Replace the test 'updates price and appends a new image for an existing SKU without duplicating' with: (a) existing SKU updates mrp/sellingPrice, title and category (seed product { id: 'p-ex', title: 'Old', categoryId: 'cat-apparel' }, row categorySlug 'Tea & Coffee' -> products[0].categoryId === 'cat-tea', title === new title); (b) non-empty imageUrls replaces images: existing old.jpg@0 + keep.jpg@1, row ['https://cdn.test/new.jpg','https://cdn.test/keep.jpg'] -> images for p-ex sorted by position equal [[new,0],[keep,1]] and old removed; (c) row without imageUrls keeps the existing images exactly; (d) unchanged round trip: a row equal to the current state (same title/category/prices/description/images in order) leaves images, positions and variant prices identical.

Same spec file: add describe('toExportRows') covering: 89900 -> 899 and 79950 -> 799.5; images given out of position order are joined by position with '|'; a product with two variants yields two rows with shared title/categorySlug/brand/imageUrl and their own sku/mrp/sellingPrice/stock; inventory null -> stock 0; brand null -> ''; zero variants -> []. Add describe('ProductService.exportRows') with a fake prisma.product.findMany that captures its args and returns one fixture product: assert args.where.status.in equals ['draft','published'] and the returned { rows } matches toExportRows of the fixture.

New apps/web/src/lib/csv.ts (pure, no React/DOM): export const CSV_BOM = '﻿'; export function parseCsv(text: string): Record<string,string>[] — character-level RFC-4180 parser: strip one leading BOM, handle quoted fields containing commas, CR/LF newlines and doubled quotes, accept 
 or 
 record ends, skip records whose cells are all blank, trim every cell (matches current bulk-page behavior), first record = headers, missing cells -> ''. export function toCsv(columns: readonly string[], rows: Record<string, string | number | null | undefined>[]): string — header line + one line per row in column order, joined with '
' plus trailing '
'; null/undefined -> ''; a field is wrapped in double quotes when it contains ',', '"', '' or '
', with inner '"' doubled.

New apps/web/src/lib/product-csv.ts (pure): export const PRODUCT_CSV_COLUMNS = ['sku','title','categorySlug','mrp','sellingPrice','description','brand','hsnCode','taxRatePct','stock','status','imageUrl'] as const (exact current COLUMNS order); export interface ProductExportRow (mirror of the API type); export function buildProductsCsv(rows: ProductExportRow[]): string => CSV_BOM + toCsv(PRODUCT_CSV_COLUMNS, rows); export function productsCsvFilename(d = new Date()): string => `belzo-products-${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}.csv` using local date parts zero-padded.

New apps/web/src/lib/csv.test.ts (pattern: apps/web/src/lib/site-content.test.ts): toCsv quotes comma/quote/newline fields and doubles inner quotes, leaves plain fields unquoted, empty for null/undefined; parseCsv strips a BOM so the first header is 'sku'; parseCsv(buildProductsCsv(rows)) round-trips a row with a comma + quote + multi-line description, '₹' and Hindi text, and an imageUrl 'https://a/x.jpg|/uploads/y.png'; numbers render as '899' / '799.5'; productsCsvFilename(new Date(2026, 0, 5)) === 'belzo-products-2026-01-05.csv'.

New apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/export-button.tsx: 'use client'; export function ExportProductsButton({ className = 'btn' }: { className?: string }). On click: setBusy; const { rows } = await adminFetch<{ rows: ProductExportRow[] }>('/admin/products/export'); const blob = new Blob([buildProductsCsv(rows)], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' }); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); create an <a> with href=url, download=productsCsvFilename(), append to body, click, remove, URL.revokeObjectURL(url). Errors: ApiClientError with payload.statusCode 401 -> 'Your admin session has expired. Please log in again and retry.', otherwise `Export failed: ${message}`; render the error in a <span role="status" className="prod-form__msg">. Button label '⬇ Export products (CSV)' ('Exporting…' while busy), type='button', disabled while busy, data-testid='export-products'. If rows is empty show 'No products to export yet.' instead of downloading.

apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/bulk/page.tsx: delete the local COLUMNS and parseCsv; import { parseCsv } from '@/lib/csv', { PRODUCT_CSV_COLUMNS } from '@/lib/product-csv', { ExportProductsButton } from '../export-button'; buildTemplate and the Columns copy use PRODUCT_CSV_COLUMNS. In section 1's admin-card__head render <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}> with <ExportProductsButton /> and the existing '⬇ Download template' link. Rewrite the section-1 copy: 'To edit existing products: Export products → edit in Excel → save as CSV UTF-8 → upload here.' Existing SKUs get title, category, MRP, selling price, description, brand, HSN, GST, stock and status updated; blank optional cells leave the current value unchanged; a non-empty imageUrl REPLACES the product's images with exactly those images in that order (first = main), a blank imageUrl keeps the current images; variants of the same product share product-level fields (title, category, description, brand, HSN, GST, status, images) — if their rows disagree the last row wins; products without variants are not exported; in Excel format the sku/hsnCode columns as Text so leading zeros are kept. Remove the old sentence 'Existing SKUs get their price updated, keep their current images, and have any new image URLs appended.' Keep all import/upload logic (image file matching, adminUpload, row mapping) otherwise unchanged. Update the result-section note to mention existing SKUs were updated.

apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/page.tsx: import { ExportProductsButton } from './export-button' and render <ExportProductsButton className="admin-inline-btn" /> in the header button group between the '⬆ Bulk upload' link and '+ Add Product' (keep padding consistent: wrap or pass style if needed).

Run all verification commands (one per call). Commit only the changed files by path: git add apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/product.service.ts apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/product.service.spec.ts apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/admin-catalogue.controller.ts apps/web/src/lib/csv.ts apps/web/src/lib/product-csv.ts apps/web/src/lib/csv.test.ts apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/export-button.tsx apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/bulk/page.tsx apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/page.tsx; commit message like 'admin catalogue: export products CSV + re-upload edits existing SKUs (title/category/fields, image replace)' with a body listing the verification results. Do not push.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/admin/products/export is guarded by the controller's @Roles('catalogue_manager') and returns { rows } with one row per variant of every draft/published product, prices in rupees, brand name or '', stock = inventory.available or 0, imageUrl = image urls by position joined with '|'

bulkUpsert on an existing SKU updates title and category, and updates description/brand/hsnCode/taxRatePct/status/stock only when provided; non-empty imageUrls replaces the image list exactly in order; missing imageUrls leaves images untouched; new-SKU behavior unchanged

pnpm --filter @belzo/api test passes including new tests for existing-SKU title/category update, image replace with order, blank imageUrl keeps images, unchanged round trip, toExportRows mapping and exportRows archived filter
apps/web/src/lib/csv.test.ts passes: RFC-4180 quoting, BOM handling, multi-line quoted fields, ₹/Hindi round trip, filename belzo-products-YYYY-MM-DD.csv

Bulk page shows '⬇ Export products (CSV)' next to the template download and the copy explains Export → edit → Upload, the replace-images rule, blank-cells-unchanged and last-row-wins; catalogue page header has the same export button
An exported file re-imports through the bulk page parser with the same column order (PRODUCT_CSV_COLUMNS === previous COLUMNS)
